messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished for release v2026.3.4 to prod/us-west-2. Kicking off post-deploy smoke checks: kv-prefill, http-heartbeat, embed-synth. Will report failures here. :rocket:
anna: seeing the deploy — can someone run the quick kv-prefill probe manually? our synthetic caught a small regression in the last patch window.
michael: I can run it. command I use locally:```bash
python infra/tools/run_smoke.py --env prod --probe kv_prefill --sample 50
```
jen: heads-up: if kv-prefill p95 > 250ms we need to pin routing to v2026.3.3 and pause the rest of the rollout. that threshold saved us last time.
sre-oncall: noted. I'll watch traces and backpressure dashboards. if we hit >5% prefills failing we'll escalate.
michael: ran the probe, partial results: 47/50 OK but 3/50 returned 503 within the prefix-warmup path. snippet:```
[kv-prefill] sample=50 ok=47 fail=3 p95=312ms errors=["503 gateway timeout","prefill-miss"]
```
anna: :eyes: that p95 is above the tolerance. did we hit any rate-limits or capacity changes?
michael: checked autoscaler logs, no scale events. no recent config flips. suspect the new allocator tweak in v2026.3.4 changed startup concurrency.
sre-oncall: confirming traces — those 503s originate from prefill worker on host ip-10-2-33-21, backend unloading cache during restart. it's correlated with a new init flag.
jen: recommendation: pin routing for prod/us-west-2 to v2026.3.3 for 30m, run a trimmed canary with the v2026.3.4 image on 10% traffic in eu to validate the init flag. file a rollback-if-needed runbook.
anna: +1 to pin. also create a quick alert to notify if p95 > 280ms during the pin window.
deploy-bot: Pinning route prod/us-west-2 -> v2026.3.3 (reason: postdeploy kv-prefill p95=312ms). Pin window=30m. Notifying rollout stakeholders.
michael: spinning up a targeted canary in eu-west1 with the new init flag reverted for testing. I'll post results in 10m.
sre-oncall: I've created alert rule: prefills.prod.us-west-2.p95 > 280ms -> pager oncall and #incidents.
jen: added runbook steps to the release ticket: include rollback command, pin rollback command, and hotfix checklist. link: https://tickets/redwood/REL-2026-3-4
anna: thanks team — keeping the main rollout paused until canary proves stable. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Update: pin applied and alerts active. If canary passes, we will schedule an automated rolling unpin and gradual re-roll with a patched image.
